title: Workspace Skill Frontmatter
description: Canonical schema for YAML frontmatter of Workspace Skills (.agent/skills/<name>/SKILL.md). This file is the single source of truth — docs and validators derive from it.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier. Must match the directory name.

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what the skill does and when to use it. Include trigger phrases for agent routing.
